descriptor: Strength training planner and session tracker

voice.summary: Sounds like a coach counting you through the last rep: short commands, specific numbers and a nod when you finish. Hype is kept for the finish line, not the warm-up.
dos: Use short imperatives like Rest, Lift, Log
Show sets, reps and kilos exactly
Give credit when a streak holds
donts: Do not use vague motivation like crush it

taglines: Strength that adds up, week by week
boilerplate: Ironleaf is a weekly workout planner that helps lifters schedule training days, track sets, time rests and review weekly volume in one dark, focused app.

microcopy.error: Set not saved. Tap to try again.

logo.note: A leaf shoot over iron-like strength fits the name: growth built from hard work.
